thread:
Elaine: Heads-up — CedarGrid reached out asking to onboard a custom 7B summarizer for financial reconciliation docs. Requirements: PHI/PII redaction, private VPC deployment, HSM for key management. Target go-live: 2026-04-10 (~3 weeks). Can we scope feasibility + list blockers? @Priya @Tom
Priya: Got it. I'm pulling their intake now. Key asks: custom tokenizer (merge with their proprietary vocab), deterministic summaries, and a safety filter that rejects account numbers and IBANs. Will upload intake doc to the ticket.
Tom: Quick clarifying Qs — is this full model fine-tune or adapter-style tuning? Artifact format? We support safetensors, .pt, and ggml. For Private + HSM we need customer's cert + KMS integration details (latency impacts). Pinging @Jonah for infra constraints.
Jonah: From infra: 7B quantized to int8 is viable. To hit p50 ~200ms at 512 tokens we should plan dedicated A100/RTX-class nodes or Mistral-optimized 8xA10-like nodes. Canary plan: shadow traffic on dedicated pool for 48h, then 5% canary. Also note: we should reserve capacity — if we miss timeline, CedarGrid flagged this as a renewal signal.
Elaine: :point_up: FYI renewal risk — their renewal window opens 2026-05-01. Delivery on schedule is a business priority.
Priya: For safety/evals I propose: 1k prompt eval set including edge cases (partial account snippets, redact patterns, legal clauses), automated PHI detection post-filter, and a small human review sample. Who picks up the eval harness?
Tom: Eng-ML can own the harness. I can scaffold a runner this week. Example runner snippet:
```bash
# eval runner snippet
python eval_harness.py --model cedargrid/7b-custom --tests tests/phi_redaction.jsonl --output results.json
```
Tom: We'll need their golden answers for deterministic summary tests, or at minimum a rubric for scoring.
Jonah: Perf test config (K8s job):
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: cedargrid-7b-perf
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: perf-run
        image: redwood/bench:latest
        args: ["--model", "cedargrid/7b-custom", "--tokens", "512", "--concurrency", "4"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```
deploy-bot: deploy-check: helm chart cedargrid-7b scheduled to deploy to staging on 4567890130 — automated smoke tests will run after pull.
Priya: Compliance Qs — do we need encrypted audit logs delivered to customer S3? Also SOC2/PCI checkbox for Private deployment. @Maya can you confirm required artifacts for audit?
Maya: I'll join the sync. We require: KMS integration proof (audit logs), encryption at rest + in transit, and a data retention policy in the intake. I can share a checklist later today.
Elaine: Action items: Elaine -> schedule call with CedarGrid (tomorrow 10am PT) to confirm dataset retention + redaction script; Tom -> validate artifact format by EOD; Jonah -> prototype perf run by Thu; Priya -> prepare 1k eval prompts and red-team list; Maya -> post compliance checklist. If any blocker arises, flag immediately — this is tied to renewal.
Priya: :white_check_mark: Uploaded intake and ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CG-1234 — I put initial notes + list of required files.
Jonah: I'll add estimated monthly cost delta for a dedicated pool to the ticket (approx +$6k/month depending on node type).
Tom: If they prefer lower cost, we can propose quantization + prefix caching to reduce mem + perf, but that will impact determinism a bit — call it out in options.
Elaine: Thanks team, appreciate the quick turnaround :raised_hands: — I'll confirm the customer call and follow up with notes after the sync.
